storyline.real: Berger wins without a tyre stop on Pirellis, his and Benetton's first win; Prost second

mastery.label: Win without a tyre stop, as Berger did

hidden.label: Win by more than Berger's real 25.4 seconds

eras.briefing: Mexico City, October 1986. Berger started fourth in the Benetton on Pirelli tyres; the Goodyear runners expect to stop. Fuel is limited to 195 litres. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports. Who led each lap is sourced; the lap times are reconstructed.
